import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void solve(Scanner sc) {
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long a = 0, b = 0;
        double bestVal = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long rem = (i * x) % y;
            long minRem = Math.min(rem, y - rem);
            double val = (double) minRem / i;
            if (val < bestVal) {
                bestVal = val;
                b = i;
                if (rem <= y - rem) {
                    a = (i * x) / y;
                } else {
                    a = (i * x) / y + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(sc);
        sc.close();
    }
}
